accepted_bridge_receipt.role: Accepted complete conditional local bridge exclusions; byte identity checked, no polynomial rerun.

domain.occupied_cells: {(x,y) in {0,...,4}^2: y != p[x]}, with p a permutation of 0,...,4
domain.aligned_square: Exactly one of the twenty occupied cells; all other tilt signs independently +/-1
mathematical_premises: Every hypothetical packing in the stated domain has the reviewed near-grid rank representation.
For a retained paired bridge, at least its horizontal or vertical forward-separating chain occurs.
The accepted local bridge result excludes every positive-cost chain; zero cost is necessary, not sufficient.

encoding.cells: Lexicographic (x,y) order within each vacancy permutation
encoding.sign_mask: Bit i=1 for positive tilt, bit i=0 for negative tilt, with the aligned cell's bit always zero
encoding.D4: Four successive rotations (x,y)->(4-y,x), each with or without reflection x->4-x; only reflections negate tilt signs
encoding.vertical_transverse_rank: 4-x, preserving tilt sign in the rotated frame

exposure: Reviewer previously read the contributor's theorem, path and sign/canonicalization programs and prior project review. Independent geometry construction, local integer-cost truth tables, constraint search and rotation/reflection implementation; not blind.
scope: Complete sign/vacancy roster satisfying the accepted paired-bridge necessary conditions, and its D4 orbits. No general-path exclusions, separation-graph enumeration, graph-to-bank coverage, unrestricted theorem or Stage 4 acceptance.
